objective: Bind all emitted source identities to finite manifest values and couple application evidence to each application; preserve legacy bytes and fail-closed quality checks.
acceptance_criteria: All emitted identity slots enumerate exact existing manifest values; flat source/pair matching remains strictly verified.
Each application emits its own nonempty evidence under an explicit independent contract marker; preserve text/order and normalize only new format.
Reject missing, mixed, parallel, foreign and malformed references; no source substitution, inference, pruning or publication relaxation.
Preserve legacy incomplete two-application/one-reference and C41 foreign-video-key rejection, plus PR94/95/96/97/98 regressions.
Tests/builds exclusively GitHub Actions; independent review before integration, no provider/runtime action.
